name: M3 Technology Inc.
summary: M3 Technology Inc., established in 2010 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, operates as a comprehensive semiconductor company. It specializes in the testing, design, production, and global distribution of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs), serving markets across Taiwan, Asia, Europe, and other international regions. The company's primary focus is on advanced power management ICs, supplying these essential chips for diverse applications in computing, telecommunications, and a wide range of consumer electronics. Its product portfolio includes various power conversion and regulation components such as buck, boost, and buck-boost converters, Low-Dropout (LDO) regulators, load switches, and charger ICs. These sophisticated solutions are integral to sectors like telecom/datacom infrastructure, Type C connectivity, and solid-state drives (SSDs).
